meta.subtitle: zone-sharding · lobby+room · matchmaker+dedicated · distributed actor service

cards.title: Spot behavior by pattern
items: ① Actors that cross a zone boundary relocate to another play node via RouteMesh.
② An Entry Spot handles entry. GetOrCreate obtains or creates the room Spot.
③ The api node handles matchmaking requests. The session node relays game messages to the prepared room Spot.
④ In an HTTP Actor service, the client calls the api node. A request by entity ID activates an Instance Spot on a play node.
The play node is the Client that calls the api node, which is the Server on the ZLink ClientServer Channel.
